note: Dos-Credobank's tariffs for services to individuals (effective 3 August 2026): keeping an individual's account is free, with no minimum balance; an account with no activity for more than twelve months is charged 500 soms, which the game doesn't count, and opening one is free for a resident and 500 soms for a non-resident.

sources.title: Dos-Credobank, Tariffs for Services Provided to Individuals (effective 3 August 2026)
sources.said: TARIFFS FOR SERVICES PROVIDED BY OPEN JOINT-STOCK COMPANY “DOS-CREDOBANK” TO INDIVIDUALS ... effective from 03 August 2026 ... Minimum account balance Not required ... Account maintenance Free of charge
